name: an-open-favourite-dragged-to-an-empty-tab-list-becomes-its-row
description:
A real cgevent drag of a favourite whose page is open and shown, down into a tab list with no rows. The drop used to remove the tile and draw no row: the tab was in the strip already, so nothing opened a row for it, and the pane went blank. The ghost row also stood in the middle of the empty pane, far below where the row lands.

What it measures: the ghost row stands directly under New Tab, and after the drop the page has a selected tab row, the tile is gone, and the page is still shown.

actions.expression: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-dropzone="favorites"] .fav'); if (!t) { return 'no tile'; } t.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: A window with no tabs opens the command bar at launch. It is not key, so an Escape misses it, and the drag's mousedown only closed it.

actions.expression: (() => { const grid = document.querySelector('[data-dropzone="favorites"]'); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow'); return (grid ? grid.querySelectorAll('.fav').length : 0) + ' tiles, ' + rows.length + ' rows'; })()

(() => { const t = document.querySelector('[data-dropzone="favorites"] .fav'); const b = t.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2) + ',' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2 + 30); })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) .newtab').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round((b.left + b.right) / 2) + ',' + Math.round(b.bottom + 160 + 30); })()

(() => { window.__ev = []; window.__gap = []; window.__cs = []; for (const t of ['pointerdown','dragstart','dragover','drop','dragend']) { document.addEventListener(t, () => { if (window.__ev[window.__ev.length-1] !== t) { window.__ev.push(t); } }, true); } document.addEventListener('dragover', () => requestAnimationFrame(() => { if (window.__ev.includes('drop')) { return; } const ghost = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .rowghost'); const nt = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) .newtab'); if (!ghost || !nt) { return; } const v = String(Math.round(ghost.getBoundingClientRect().top - nt.getBoundingClientRect().bottom)); if (window.__gap[window.__gap.length-1] !== v) { window.__gap.push(v); } }), true); const orig = chrome.send.bind(chrome); chrome.send = (name, args) => { if (name === 'sidebarFavoriteMovedOut') { window.__cs.push(name + ':' + args.map((a) => String(a).split('/').pop()).join(',')); } return orig(name, args); }; return 'spying'; })()

(() => { const grid = document.querySelector('[data-dropzone="favorites"]'); const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; const sel = rows.find((r) => r.classList.contains('sel')); return grid.querySelectorAll('.fav').length + ' tiles, ' + rows.length + ' rows, ' + (sel ? 'selected ' + sel.querySelector('.tl').textContent : 'none selected'); })()
actions.expected: 1 tiles, 1 rows, selected Blue Favicon Site

assertions.desc: the launch command bar closed before the drag
gates the drag: the open favourite has no row and the tab list is empty
the ghost row stood directly under New Tab, one list gap below it, the whole way
one move out of the grid, to the top of the tab list

assertions.expected: 1 tiles, 1 rows, selected Blue Favicon Site
assertions.desc: THE MEASUREMENT: the open page became the selected tab row and its tile went
the page is still shown in the content pane
